short_description: Consumer lag on the orders queue due to high order volume during an unplanned flash sale.
trigger: Flash sale sent four times the normal order volume.
problem_statement: Two workers could not keep up and the orders topic built a backlog of 52,000 messages.
impact_description: Orders were taken but confirmed up to 25 minutes late.

timeline.event: Flash sale started. None. The sale was not on the capacity calendar.
Alert OrderQueueConsumerLagHigh fired with lag at 14,000. On-call opened an incident and followed SOP-QUEUE-001.
Workers restarted. Lag kept growing. Asked the orders team for help.
Orders team joined. Scaled orders-worker from 2 to 4 replicas.
Lag back under 1,000. Closed the incident.

root_causes: Worker capacity was fixed at normal traffic levels and the sale was not planned for.
The lag procedure in use restarted workers, which added no capacity.

action_items.action: Replace SOP-QUEUE-001 with a procedure that scales consumers.
Add sales events to the capacity calendar.
